checks.name: accented Latin transliteration
checks.sql: SELECT demo.main.slugify(v) FROM (VALUES (1, '  --Crème Brûlée--  '), (2, 'Ångström Øresund Straße'), (3, 'Łódź & Kraków'), (4, 'Æsir/Œuvre__Þorn')) t(id, v) ORDER BY id

checks.name: whitespace and punctuation runs collapse, edges trimmed
checks.sql: SELECT demo.main.slugify(v) FROM (VALUES (1, E'multiple   spaces\t\nand...dots'), (2, 'Version 2.0 (beta)'), (3, '!!!'), (4, '')) t(id, v) ORDER BY id

checks.name: SQL NULL preserved
checks.sql: SELECT demo.main.slugify(CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)) IS NULL, demo.main.slugify(v) FROM (VALUES (1, 'A B'), (2, NULL), (3, 'C')) t(id, v) ORDER BY id

checks.name: multiple batches with interleaved NULLs
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(s), count(DISTINCT s), min(s), max(s) FROM (SELECT demo.main.slugify(CASE WHEN i % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'Item #' || i || ' Café' END) AS s FROM range(5000) t(i))

checks.name: empty input
checks.sql: SELECT count(demo.main.slugify(v)) FROM (SELECT 'x' AS v WHERE false)
